items.text:
# CASTING CALL – STUDENT SHORT FILM | BRISTOL

Hello everyone!

My name is Jonny, and I’m a third-year Filmmaking student at the University of the West of England (UWE Bristol). I’m currently producing a short film called *Opsequium*, and we’re looking for **two actors** to join the project!
## ABOUT THE film 

**GENRE:** Dystopian Sci-Fi, Political Drama, Psychological Thriller

**Logline:**
In the near future, a government officer is sent to retire a 'dangerous criminal' only to find an older man, a veteran with ptsd who confronts him on his morals.

**Synopsis:**

In the near future, a totalitarian government rules society. We follow a government officer on his final assignment as he prepares to leave his position. However, he is tasked with forcibly “retiring” a supposedly dangerous war veteran suffering from PTSD, forcing him to confront the reality of the system he serves.
## ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Government Officer**
* **Playing age:** 20s–early 30s
* A government officer approaching the end of his service, faced with a morally challenging final assignment.

**2. War Veteran**
* **Playing age:** 40s–late 60s
* A war veteran suffering from PTSD who has been labelled dangerous by the government.
## ROLE DETAILS
* **Location:** Bristol and surrounding areas
* **Filming window:** 22nd–25th November 2026, with exact shoot dates to be confirmed
* **Commitment:** Voluntary roles as part of a student film production

Travel expenses to and from the filming location will be covered, and food will be provided on shooting days.
## INTERESTED?

If you’re interested in either role or would like to find out more, please email me at **[Jonnymoralee@outlook.com](mailto:Jonnymoralee@outlook.com)**.

You can also check out my YouTube channel to see some of the films I’ve worked on at UWE:

[https://www.youtube.com/@JonnyFernandezFilm](https://www.youtube.com/@JonnyFernandezFilm)

Please feel free to get in touch or share this post with anyone who might be interested!

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Jonny

Actors, we’d love to invite you to our Christmas party! 🎄🥂
We’ve already had actors, casting directors and agents confirm they’re coming, and we’d love you to join us for a night of meeting people and celebrating the year together.

Worried about coming on your own? Most people do and still have the best night -so please don’t let that stop you!

We’ll also be hosting our casting director and agent awards, making it an extra special evening of celebrations. ✨

📍 Holborn, Central London

🗓 Sunday 6th December 2026

⏰ 6pm–late

Entry is guest-list only, so book your place at Hey! Just wanted to invite you to our Mixing Mixer Christmas Party 🎄 Sunday 6th December in Holborn, from 6pm until late!

Would love to see you there! It’s guest-list only, so book your place now: https://mixingnetworks.com/Event

We’d love to see you there!

Casting Call - Blackpool Region. Sept/Oct 2027.

The Tosser Squad. A Mockumentary/Parody film, set in a small call centre. 

Written by Rob Gushue and Chris Jackson. 

To most, an unwelcome disruption, but to an ever-growing group of honest, hardworking people all over the globe, it is a Way Of Life. A noble profession. And in one call center, they will do whatever it takes to Close The Sale. That is, if they can handle working together without killing each other.

Based loosely on the 2011 short series The Telemarketers

Various roles will be available.

Roles that are available (so far):

Mick - the owner of the business. He is not all together there. Forgetful, always late to the office, can't remember where he parks his car, always gets peoples names wrong. Has habit of moving people around to different desks as it "feels right", but then doesn't. 

Rachel - The Pep-Talk queen. She is the one who gives one-liner boost chats to the team. Comes out with stuff such as "This tele-calling revolution is not going to start itself, gang". When she is not giving her "words of wisdom", she is nowhere to be found. 

Karen The Crazy Cat Lady - Forever single. Likes dressing her pet in silly outfits and bring him (Mr Wobbles) to work. She thinks its cute but annoys everyone else. 

Gonzales - Originally from SE Asia. He can dance and sing like MJ, and likes to be called "The Ricky Martin" of the group. He likes hitting the sales numbers, and showing off his skills to his rival Navarro.

Navarro (Nav-Man). A Top Gun in the sales room. He is always in competition with Gonzales. Everyone thinks that he is not all there, especially his mysterious life outside of work. 

Patrick "Tiny" The Angry Accountant- He is business smart dwarf but has zero tolerance for idiots and especially Gonzales. Dresses smart, well above his pay grade. When he is on the phone to customers, he is always pleasant, but as soon as he is done with the call, his natural personalithy kicks in and starts yelling at coworkers, as he cant work out the payroll system which is an ancient as Mick. 

Barry Goc. He calls himself Goc The C***. But everyone just thinks he's a D***head. 

*Matt - almost like a Matthew McConaughey, talks slow deliberately, and you have no idea where he's going but his voice is so soothing, you just stay. Think almost like Jim Carey's impersonation of McConaughey. Likes to play Ukulele naked in his flat. Never says he gets stoned, but always talks about a "Fragrant scent around his flat" Turns out his neighbors blaze up so much he gets second hand stoning. But everyone thinks he smokes it. Fav saying "It's all the Vide man"

The Bandit - Has a habit of leaving sticky notes around the office. No one knows who he/she is. 

Bertha - Middle aged. her hobbies ar making cookies, mostly for Navarro. 

Jared (Salty Boy) - Salty Boy for a reason. His desk is cluttered with salty snacks, and everything is always controlled chaos. Lives with his mom, even though he's in his late 40's. 

Sharon (Shaz) The receptionist - Forever dateless. She messes everything up due to her lack of any coordination. Every guy who enters the office, she tries hard to get a date, but fails. She thinks that Goc is "Dreamy" but thinks he is such a A-Hole. 

Other characters will be added.

Extra Character traits
Mick:
● Squirrel On Crack. People make the joke they’re gonna get a shock collar to keep him on track in a conversation.
● You can always find him by following the trail of destruction.
● Has answered a stapler instead of cell phone before
● 80 things on the go, might get 1 or 2 done, but not the ones he needed to
● No idea how landlines work or simple stuff like transferring calls, can’t find a pen or paper to take notes or messages

Rachel/Sticky Note Bandit:
● Mick calls her by another name and has no idea who “Rachel” is. He seems to think the staff named a ghost.
● Very bad shorthand techniques, and leave them on sticky notes on Mick's door for meeting minutes (color of the notes are how important the message is). Mick takes them as threats.
● Since staff don’t pay attention to her, they have no idea about the notes when asked, nobody clues in.
● Everyone thinks what name Mick calls her is the new employee because Rachel disappears.

Karen:
● Thinks Navarro is Spanish because of his last name and asks questions to make her new Spanish bred Maine Coon feel more at home from Spain. Navarro is neither Spanish, nor does he know anything she asks him about.
● Has a pic of a cat dressed up at Christmas time with a pic of Santa. In the photo, neither the cat, nor Santa are impressed. 

Gonzales:
● Guy is great with metrics, but has no idea how to set up a presentation, or hook stuff up to his computer. Knows every detail about the internet ever.

Navarro:
● Everyone thinks he’s gay because of some very timely co-incidences I.e. Sees a person in drag walking a beautiful dog and everyone thinks he’s looking at the person in drag with the comments. He knows how to pair colors and patterns, and
always compliments a really good nail job.

Gok:
● He thinks he knows everything, and talks a big game, but he’s an idiot with his facts
● Always misquoting some fact or conversation.
● VERY OCD. Hates Jared because of the way his cubicle is, because he likes organization, and cleanliness

Bertha:
● Sees Navarro as the son she never had

Jared:
● Deliberately drive Goc nuts with a messy cubicle
● Plays on Goc’s OCD and will sneakily move things while talking to set him off afterwards.

Casting Call - feature film
We are currently looking for a male presenting actor (Age range of 25 - 35). It's a dual role, playing a pair of twin vampire henchmen for our horror comedy, Love In Vein. 

Our next shoot is 15th November, in Brighton, and will recur on the odd weekend moving forward. The project has been pieced together though both cast and crew kindly volunteering their time to bring the project to life on weekends, so it's unpaid at present. We do cover expenses though such as food, travel and accommodation. We understand the prioritisation of paid work, so we'll work around you. We can also to offer any creative exchange such as headshots, editing casting reels and filming audition tapes. 

Teaser Trailer to the film below! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ua2hzPuj770

Synopsis of the Film 

Love in Vein follows Evelyn and Peter. Evelyn is a vampire with a heart, using a dating app called WinkedIn to lure men in. She never kills them though, only taking what she needs. Peter is a mild-mannered photography student, looking for love. Using WinkedIn, he ends up on a date with Evelyn. A romance between the two is ignited and both of their worlds turn upside down, soon to be further complicated by a spector of Evelyn’s past… 

If you're interested, please drop an email to: 

loveinveincasting@gmail.com

Thanks and looking forward to hearing from some of you!

**Authentische Schauspieler gesucht – Raum München – faire Bezahlung**

Wir sind **RoRoh** – natürliche Lebensmittel mit Charakter (Rohkakao, Bio-Rohriegel, Kokos & GOAT Protein). Wir suchen Gesichter, die genauso echt sind wie unsere Produkte.

Keine Hochglanz-Schauspieler, keine auswendig gelernten Zeilen – sondern Menschen mit echter Energie, die vor der Kamera einfach sie selbst bleiben.

📍 Raum München · ein Drehtag im Zeitraum 11.–13.11
⏱ ~4–6 Std. pro Dreh · faire Bezahlung · und wenn die Chemie stimmt, gerne öfter

Bewerbung in unter 5 Minuten, inkl. kurzem Selbstvideo 👇

**Authentische Schauspieler gesucht – Raum München – faire Bezahlung**

Wir sind **RoRoh** – natürliche Lebensmittel mit Charakter (Rohkakao, Bio-Rohriegel, Kokos & GOAT Protein). Wir suchen Gesichter, die genauso echt sind wie unsere Produkte.

Keine Hochglanz-Schauspieler, keine auswendig gelernten Zeilen – sondern Menschen mit echter Energie, die vor der Kamera einfach sie selbst bleiben.

📍 Raum München · ein Drehtag im Zeitraum 11.–13.11
⏱ ~4–6 Std. pro Dreh · faire Bezahlung · und wenn die Chemie stimmt, gerne öfter

Bewerbung in unter 5 Minuten, inkl. kurzem Selbstvideo 👇
[https://form.typeform.com/to/XB9vlK3j](https://form.typeform.com/to/XB9vlK3j)

items.text:
Hello, everyone! I’m casting for a surreal indie feature with an “early-cinema” look, with painted faces and vaudevillian/storybookish costumes…the material at turns dark, silly, poetic, musical…basically, “art film”! To get a sense of the style, you can see my work on YouTube at Candy Town Follies, and on TikTok at Candy Town Scandals.

[https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies](https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies)

https://www.tiktok.com/@mrdobbs

We're looking to cast a Caucasian boy, between the age of 10 and 13, to play the male lead. We’ll be shooting through to the middle of next year, in Chicago and in Elgin Illinois, with plans to get it out to the film festival circuit by the end of the year. Unfortunately, there’s no pay, as what budget we have will have to be spent on production…but we do feed everyone at the shoots, the film will be listed on IMDB, and all the actors sign contracts which entitle them to a share of the proceeds, if the movie were to make money.

If you’re a stage parent, have a son about that age, and might be interested…please contact me here or at ctfollies@gmail.com …or if you KNOW a stage parent with a son this age, please please please pass this along! Thanks so much!

🟢 ZOSTAŃ NASZĄ KELLY 🟢

Szukamy osoby, która zagra rolę Kelly w DWÓCH spektaklach w reżyserii @just_sobczyk: 
🤖 Kelly kontra Big Tech w @teatr_zeromskiego_kielce
🙆 Kelly 🟢 w @teatr_ochoty

Musisz mieć:
🎂 18-25 lat;
👯 Doświadczenie sceniczne.

Jak wziąć udział w castingu?
📝 Wypełnij formularz dostępny w opisie instagrama @teatr_ochoty i na stronie Teatru Ochoty (przygotuj CV, informację/portfolio o swoim doświadczeniu artystycznym i zadanie castingowe ⬇️)

ZADANIE CASTINGOWE 🎭
Nagraj film (1,5 minuty), w którym jesteś Kelly podczas streamu.
Wybierz dowolną, zwyczajną czynność (coś, co mogłoby wydarzyć się w jej codziennym życiu). Możesz jeść, robić makijaż, sprzątać pokój, gotować, malować paznokcie, grać, leżeć w łóżku, przygotowywać się do wyjścia albo wybrać coś zupełnie innego.
Potraktuj nagranie jak próbę wejścia w jej sposób bycia online.
Nie musisz imitować konkretnej platformy ani tworzyć profesjonalnego streamu. 
Jakość techniczna nagrania nie ma znaczenia. Telefon wystarczy.
Możesz improwizować, możesz przygotować sobie punkt wyjścia, możesz pozwolić, żeby sytuacja rozwijała się spontanicznie. Nie szukamy gotowej interpretacji! Chcemy zobaczyć, jak badasz tę postać.

Wybrane osoby zaprosimy do II etapu, który będzie miał formę stacjonarnych warsztatów w Teatrze Ochoty w Warszawie 🥳

‼️UWAGA‼️
Prace nad spektaklem będą realizowane przede wszystkim w Teatrze im. Stefana Żeromskiego w Kielcach w terminie 12.01–13.03. Przedstawienie składa się z dwóch autonomicznych części. W założeniu aktorka wcielająca się w postać Kelly pozostaje tą samą osobą w obu częściach spektaklu – zarówno w części warszawskiej, jak i kieleckiej, odtwarzając w nich tę samą rolę.
📆 WAŻNE TERMINY
7.10 — początek przyjmowania zgłoszeń
7.10–27.10 — I etap naboru
1/2/3.12 — II etap - warsztaty teatralne w Teatrze Ochoty - i ostateczny wybór Kelly
12.01.2027 – początek prób do spektaklu (głównie w Kielcach)
13.03.2027 – kielecka premiera - KELLY KONTRA BIG TECH
19.03.2027 – warszawska premiera - KELLY 🟢

🔥 Nie czekaj, zgłoś się już dziś 🔥

🎬 WHEN IT GOES QUIET, CHECK THE CALENDAR 🎬

When you question why times are quiet and if you should stay in the game... check the calendar.

Instead, navigate what you and/or your agent can do to make the most of busy or quiet months.

That’s why I made a general UK acting industry calendar for a year. When productions are green-lit, and when it goes quiet.

Because quiet months aren’t a sign you’re failing. They’re part of the cycle. We all feel them.

📌 JAN — Reset, green-light, continuing dramas book
📌 FEB/MAR — Indie film & theatre cast
📌 APR/MAY — Day player peak
📌 JUN/JUL — Shoot season, breakdowns dip
📌 AUG — Quiet month, CDs away
📌 SEP/OCT — Second green-light, best time for agent meetings
📌 NOV — Last push for winter storylines
📌 DEC — Industry shuts down

#UKActor #BritishActor #SpotlightActor #ActorLifeUK #SupportBritishActors

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

**STAND-IN / EXTRAS / WARSAW / CHILDREN & TEENAGERS**

We're looking for stand-ins / extras aged **1 to 17** for a movie project - no experience required, you will be asked to do very simple tasks like "opening fridge", "sitting on couch" or "turning on TV".

We are looking for kids and teenagers of the following ethnic backgrounds / appearances:
* African
* Hispanic
* Asian
* Indian

**Where:** Warsaw, Ciechanowska street.
**When:** One day between October 29th and November 6th. The shoot will take approximately 1.5 hours.
**Rate:** PLN 500, paid via BLIK. **If you come from another city, we can cover some travel expanses.**

If you are interested, please email **atlanta.int.casting@gmail.com** with the following information:
* full name
* age
* contact phone number
* current photos

You can check our agency here: www.atlantafilms.pl

🎃 Looking for a fun Halloween plan this Friday? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Meininger Hotel Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone is placed in a mixed team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

Wymagania: szczupła sylwetka, atrakcyjny wygląd, wzrost około 170 cm.

**Umowa:** umowa o dzieło

**Termin i lokalizacja zdjęć:** początek listopada, Łódź lub okolice

Good afternoon,

I work in the marketing department for a London based dental group.

We're aiming to shoot a series of short video ads for an upcoming Invisalign campaign. 

We're looking for actors/models of any age and gender to join us in London for a day of filming late November. Although not compulsory, we will favor anyone who is currently using Invisalign or any other form of clear aligner system for straightening their teeth. 

This is a paid opportunity.

Thanks!

**URGENT: Looking for cast - Passion project - short fan film (1 day shoot)**

I'm making a Sirius Black fan film set on the night the Potter's died. Because this is a fan film/passion project there is no pay, but travel reimbursements are available within reason (I can't really afford much more than £10 without further discussion) but you will be free to keep and use the footage as you like once finished (I aim to get it finished before December)

Shooting will be a single day for all but one cast member and even less than half that for some.
Please let me know if you are interested. and get in touch if you have any further questions.

**Shooting block dates:**
**2nd-4th November**

**Location: Monmouthshire **

**Cast:**

**Lily Potter - 20's, Female (Red hair/wig preferable)**

**James Potter - 20's, Male (Dark hair preferable, glasses)**

**Remus Lupin - 20's, Male (Brown hair preferable)**

**Peter Pettigrew - 20's, Male (preferably short) (Pettigrew will be required for at least one additional day later in the shoot block)**

**Albus Dumbledore - 70-90, Male, long beard**

I want to be able to build a local community of like-minded creatives who gather and make fun silly little projects with each other while helping build our own portfolios and then creating strong connections for future paid projects.

I understand some people might find this controversial, and I respect that, but I want to keep this open and accepting despite the creators views.

We are now in Preliminary Casting for The Prodigal Daughter. 

Set to the Biblical parable of the Prodigal Son. Is a famous story about a father who welcomes back his rebellious younger son with joy, despite the son wasting his inheritance, while the faithful older brother remains resentful. 

This story sets the stage for a daughter (early 20's) who gets her inheritance share from her late grandmother, and she thinks she can make it on her own. 

Rather than listen to the wisdom of her parents, she is rebellious and moves into a small studio apartment and takes the false advice of those who she thinks are her friends. With the influence of her "friends" she soon squanders her inheritance, and ends up loosing her studio apartment, turns to a life of drugs and prostitution..
In a state of despair, she take a blade to slit her wrists and end her life. It is true a sheer act of redemption that she decides to return back to the family home to seek forgiveness from her parents.

A story that is gripping and shows the real struggles of many that are homeless and wanting a way home, through hope.

NOTE: ALL LEAD ROLES ARE NOW GONE. ONLY LOOKING FOR SUPPORT ACTORS. 

FILMING: BLACKPOOL AREA. APRIL 2027

CASTING NOTICE: MOUNT VERNON’S FAVORITE SON

I am excited to announce that we are now casting day players for our independent short film, Mount Vernon's Favorite Son.

We are seeking performers of any experience who are ready to bring professionalism and energy to the set. This is an excellent opportunity for actors and non-actors looking to build their resume and collaborate with a passionate local production team based in Mount Vernon, New York.

Available Roles: Dialogue-driven rideshare/taxi passengers. For various ages and backgrounds. 

Submission Process: Please email mountvernonsfavoriteson@gmail.com with your headshot, resume, portfolio, and especially any skill sets you'd like to show off. Skills can include musical or dance, or vocational backgrounds like legal or comedic, as this can bring a unique quirk to your character and influence your performance. 

We want to work with your film character, customized to your abilities. 

Please feel free to share this opportunity with your professional network. And if you'd like to bring to a friend along with you on-set, the more the merrier. Low time commitment, footage for your reel, and a great opportunity to connect.

**Logline:** When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she’s really there.

We’re looking for actors who connect with the characters and are looking for something interesting to play. If David or Bridget catches your attention, we’d love to see your audition.

**Shooting Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada

NEED SOMEONE TO PLAY THE MOM FOR TMRWS CLASS. URGENT. DM if available

*ISO: Melanie (30-50)

A loving but overwhelmed single mother raising her teenage daughter, Tracy, while trying to maintain her own sobriety and rebuild her life. She works as a hairdresser from home and struggles to balance being a parent, a provider, and someone who wants to be her daughter's friend. As Tracy's behavior becomes increasingly destructive, Melanie must confront how little she understands about what her daughter is experiencing. She is warm, energetic, outspoken, imperfect, and emotionally vulnerable. Beneath her casual, sometimes youthful personality is a woman who desperately wants to protect her daughter but fears losing her connection with her

Male actors wanted for The Crucible this coming February. Rehearsals start November 1
Calling all mature male actors in Ottawa-Gatineau. 

Rehearsals will be Sundays 1-5 and Wednesdays 6-8:30 with a break from December 16 to January 6.

We're urgently looking for a few more male actors to fill supporting and smaller roles in our community theatre production of Arthur Miller's The Crucible. 

We're looking for enthusiastic performers who enjoy bringing interesting characters to life. 

We have a large group of actors already to go. We just want to fill in these parts strongly. 

Auditions, please reach out ASAP. 

We are holding callbacks tonight, Thursday, October twenty-second, and would welcome interested actors who are available to join us. 

Can't make it tonight? 

No problem. 

We're also accepting video auditions. Video audition deadline, Friday, October 30.

If you're interested, please send me a private message as soon as possible and I'll provide the details. 

Please share this post with anyone you think might be interested. Natalie Fraser, director, The Crucible.

Connect@nataliefraser.ca

items.text:
**Volljährige Darstellerin für 3 kurze Smartphone-Videos gesucht – 200 €**

Wir sind HS-Systeme, ein deutscher Hersteller unter der Marke Magic Motion, und suchen eine sympathische, volljährige Darstellerin für drei kurze Videoaufnahmen.

Die Videos können bequem zu Hause mit einem guten Smartphone aufgenommen werden.

**Was wir suchen:**
* Drei Videos von jeweils ca. 3 Minuten
* Gesicht und ein Teil der Arme im Bild
* Direkter Blickkontakt, natürliche Mimik und Bewegungen
* Drei unterschiedliche Looks durch Frisur, Kleidung oder Make-up
* Keine Sprache
* Keine Nacktheit, kein Ausziehen, keine freizügige Kleidung erforderlich

Die Aufnahmen sind für einen digitalen Bonusbereich im Zusammenhang mit einem Erwachsenenprodukt vorgesehen. Über den konkreten Inhalt informieren wir vor der Beauftragung vollständig.

**Vergütung: 200 € insgesamt**, einschließlich der schriftlich vereinbarten kommerziellen Nutzungsrechte.

Bei Interesse freuen wir uns über eine private Nachricht.

Grüße 

Helmut

ROLLENAUSSCHREIBUNG: Frauen und Männer 55–75 für Handy-Aufnahmen zu Hause (Online-Werbung)

Projekt: Werbevideos für FITprofil, eine App mit Band fürs Handgelenk (Berlin)

Gesucht: 3 Personen, Frau oder Mann, 55–75 Jahre, ganz normaler Typ, keine Kamera-Erfahrung nötig

Umfang: Band und App 7 Tage im Alltag nutzen, danach ca. 20 Minuten Aufnahmen mit dem eigenen Handy nach einer einfachen Anleitung. Kein Text zum Auswendiglernen: Gesagt wird nur, was für dich stimmt.

Drehort: bei dir zu Hause (Versand des Bands nach DE, AT oder CH)

Zeitraum: Auswahl bis 30.10., Versand ab 31.10., Aufnahmen bis 12.11.

Gage: 80 € nach Abnahme, dazu das Band zum Behalten und 1 Jahr FITprofil PRO

Verwendung: Online-Werbung (Social Media, Website, App Stores), 24 Monate, schriftliche Vereinbarung vorab. Gesicht und Stimme werden nicht mit KI verändert.

Bewerbung per PN: Alter, Wohnort, ein aktuelles Foto oder ein 10-Sekunden-Video, in dem du dich kurz vorstellst.

🎸 SZUKAMY STATYSTÓW DO SCENY KONCERTOWEJ! PUNKOWY KLIMAT, WARSZAWA, 2 LISTOPADA 🖤
Hej! 🖤

Szukamy osób do udziału w scenie koncertowej w studenckim filmie fabularnym realizowanym przez Warszawską Szkołę Filmową.

To naprawdę świetny, ambitny projekt z bardzo ciekawym scenariuszem, w który wkładamy dużo serca i energii! 🔥 Chcemy stworzyć wyjątkowy klimat koncertu na squacie, dlatego szukamy osób, które pomogą nam zbudować autentyczną, punkową atmosferę.

🤘 Kogo szukamy?

* Osób w każdym wieku, ale idealnie w przedziale 20–40 lat.
* Osób, które czują klimat punku, gotyku, alternatywy i undergroundowej sceny muzycznej.
* Osób posiadających własne ubrania pasujące do tej estetyki — skórzane kurtki, glany, ćwieki, ciemne stylizacje, punkowe i gotyckie dodatki. Im bardziej autentycznie, tym lepiej! 🖤

📅 Data zdjęć: 2 listopada
📍 Miejsce: Warszawa
🎬 Scena: koncert na squacie

Zdjęcia będą realizowane na zewnątrz, ale zapewniamy dostęp do pomieszczenia, w którym będzie można się ogrzać.

💸 Wynagrodzenie: 50 zł.

Wiemy, że nie jest to duża stawka, i prosimy o wyrozumiałość. Jesteśmy studentami realizującymi niezależny projekt i staramy się zaoferować chociaż symboliczną kwotę za Wasz czas i zaangażowanie. Będziemy ogromnie wdzięczni każdej osobie, która zechce dołączyć do naszego filmu i pomóc nam stworzyć coś naprawdę fajnego! ❤️

Jeśli czujesz ten klimat i masz odpowiednią stylówkę, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej! Możesz też od razu wysłać swoje zdjęcie lub zdjęcie stylizacji.

Będzie nam super miło, jeśli dołączysz do naszego projektu! 🖤🤘

Do zobaczenia pod sceną!

**STAND-IN / EXTRAS / WARSAW / CHILDREN & TEENAGERS**

We're looking for stand-ins / extras aged **1 to 17** for a movie project - no experience required, you will be asked to do very simple tasks like "opening fridge", "sitting on couch" or "turning on TV".

We are looking for kids and teenagers of the following ethnic backgrounds / appearances:
* African
* Hispanic
* Asian
* Indian

**Where:** Warsaw, Ciechanowska street.
**When:** One day between October 29th and November 6th. The shoot will take approximately 1.5 hours.
**Rate:** PLN 500, paid via BLIK. **If you come from another city, we can cover some travel expanses.**

If you are interested, please email **atlanta.int.casting@gmail.com** with the following information:
* full name
* age
* contact phone number
* current photos

You can check our agency here: www.atlantafilms.pl

Dans quelques semaines ou jours ce sera la toute  première de Smiley  et le coeur commence à battre 😀
Nous serons ravis de vous compter parmi nos spectateurs pour nous soutenir et vibrer avec nous !!

 Vous pourrez assister à la rencontre de Bruno et Alex au Théâtre A la Folie Théâtre 75011 Paris. 
Les représentations  auront lieu tous les Jeudis, Vendredi et Samedi à 21h30 et ce jusqu'au 30 Janvier !!!!
Smiley est une comédie romantique drôle et touchante que nous avons adapté de l'espagnol  avec mon partenaire de scène Nicolas Desnoues.
Smiley c'est aussi  un reflet sans fard sur les hasards et les difficultés des rencontres sur les réseaux et autres applications.
Bruno et Alex n'ont à priori rien en commun, aussi bien dans leur mode de vie que dans leurs centres d'intérêts.
A la suite d'un quiproquo ils vont se rencontrer.
Et si, malgré leurs différences, ils étaient fait pour vivre une belle histoire? 

Si également vous pouvez diffuser l'information autour de vous , ce sera notre meilleure publicité 😉
Merci par avance !

A très très bientôt !!!

Pascal Seguin 😃

**EXTRAS NEEDED – Short Film “GORGE” (SAG-AFTRA Micro-Budget Project) – Santa Ana, CA**

We’re casting **extras (diner customers)** for GORGE, a short drama directed by Dylan Boom, shooting **Monday 11/9 and Tuesday 11/10 in Santa Ana, CA**.

**Role:** Extras / diner customers, with some featured-extra moments possible. Flexible hours, a few hours on set.

**Who:** adults 18+, all looks and types.

**Compensation:** You’ll receive a copy of the final film for your reel, meal on set, and credit.

**Please note:** this is a SAG-AFTRA Micro-Budget Project, so it **does not** include SAG vouchers and doesn’t count toward union membership eligibility. All performers sign a Micro-Budget acknowledgment before working. SAG members are welcome to apply, but please keep that in mind.

**To apply:** send me a message with your name, a headshot or recent photo, and which day(s) you’re available (11/9, 11/10, or both). Location and call details will be sent once you’re booked.

Thank you!

Hello All - My name is Shweta Walia and I am a Co-Producer of an upcoming South Asian Film called "The Ideal". The Ideal is being shot in multiple locations (Reston, Herndon, Ashburn) in Northern Virginia from Thursday, Nov 12th to Sunday Nov15th. We're looking for some Extras to be featured in this short film! Our team is looking for those who are curious about being in a professional film set and can wear traditional South Asian attire on set. It will only take a few hours. Food is provided. If interested, please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com with the email subject: Interest as [ROLE] Extra - NAME, or DM us @treelineproductions!

Please see flyer for Role details, date and location of shooting.

**About the Film**

The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite

following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while

the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their

reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to

surface.

sharedPost.text:
Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 44/2026

MONSTERTIME ZU HALLOWEEN, EINE ÖSTERREICHISCHE LITERATURIKONE UND VIELE INTERVIEWS 

Pünktlich zum Samhain Fest starten mit OTHER MOMMY und MONSTER MIA genreübliche Filme. Ob die Titel das einhalten was diese suggerieren, erzählt Ihnen Moderatorin Sarah Fuchs. 

Sie gilt als die Schriftstellerin Österreichs nach 1945. Nöstlinger – Sowieso und überhaupt“ von Regisseurin Alexandra Schneider porträtiert die Autorin nicht nur filmisch,  wir konnten die Regisseurin vor unser Mikro bitten.

Üblicherweise ist er auf Ö3 der Muntermacher der Nation. Philipp Hansa erzählt uns über seine erste Synchronrolle und Thomas Sieben stellt höchstpersönlich im Gespräch seinen neuesten Thriller UNSAFE vor.

Natürlich darf bei uns die Musik nicht fehlen. Wir spielen die besten Musik aus den besten Filmen aller Zeiten.

Mittwoch 28.10.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
**ŚLĄSK I OKOLICE...**

Do 2 sezonu **GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK, odcinek "muzyczny":)** szukam:

**Roman Hoffman (42)**–gitarzysta bluesowy, w 1 scenie gra na gitarze. Długie włosy. Charyzmatyczny romantyk, trudny w relacjach biznesowych. Dawniej zmagał się z narkotykami. 

**nagranie 3 i 6.11**

**stawka 600 zł za dzień**

**Jan Chodakowski „Jim” (25)**–Inteligentny, cyniczny, mściwy. Pracuje jako barman. Ubiera się w granatowe jeansy, czarny T-shirt, czarny-sweter i czarną kurtkę.

**nagranie 3 i 6.11**

**stawka 800 zł za dzień**

**Gosia Zduńczyk (18) –**tegoroczna maturzystka, córka Marka Zduńczyka. Zafascynowana Hoffmanem. Impulsywna romantyczka i buntowniczka. Ubiera się jeansy, bluzki, sweter, płaszcz.Drobna blondynka.

**nagranie 3.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Marek Zduńczyk (45)**– prawnik. Pewny siebie, stanowczy, porywczy i nadopiekuńczy. Sprawia wrażenie człowieka przyzwyczajonego do kontroli. Zadbany, ubrany elegancko lub w stylu smart casual.** prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 3 i 7.11**

**stawka 700 zł za dzień**

**Barmanka (27)**– pracownica bluesowego pubu. Bezpośrednia, spostrzegawcza i obyta z klientami. Atrakcyjna, swobodna, ubrana odpowiednio do pracy za barem.

**nagranie 6.11**

**stawka 600 zł**

**Iza Styczyńska „Izzy” (40) –**była basistka.Twarda, konkretna, niezależna i nieufna. Zadbana, wysportowana, o wyrazistym rockowym stylu.** prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 5 i 6.11**

**stawka 800 zł za dzień**

**Tomasz Napiórowski „Napiór” (39)**–diler narkotyków. Cwaniacki, bezczelny, pewny siebie i obyty z policją. Dobra sylwetka, wygląd człowieka z półświatka. Ubiera się wygodnie, ale modnie.

**nagranie 5.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Krzysztof Adamski (39) –**znany wokalista. Charyzmatyczny, pewny siebie, dumny. Zadbany, ubrany w stylu boho.

**nagranie 3.11**

**stawka 600 zł, 1 scena**

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na email **obsadaolga@gmail.com**

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie demo lub wizytówkę.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

You watch your self-tape back and think: “That’s not what I meant to do.”

You understood the scene. You felt connected to it. But on camera, the performance looks flat, forced or completely different from what you intended.

And when nobody gives you feedback, how are you supposed to know what to change?

In this FREE live Acting Masterclass, Michael Keogh (Peaky Blinders, Casualty, Marvel’s Secret Invasion) will show you what makes a performance connect on camera, why overthinking can flatten a scene, and how to create emotion without forcing it.

Sunday November 1st at 6pm UK time / 1pm ET

Attend live and receive a FREE bonus valued at $97.

RSVP NOW at the following link: 

https://bit.ly/4pCzU5V

items.text: This one hurts...I first met Eric years ago (Way before Looney Tunes) at one of the big voice over party's at Joe Cipriano's. We hit it off and hung at the same table for quite a while. Affable, funny, crazy talented, he was just getting started and had no idea rhere he was headed. We'd cross paths over the years and it was like no time had transpired. The last time we caught up was at  One Voice Dallas in 2024 and it was a complete honor to be on the Animation panel with him. God bless buddy, Rest In Peace. Heaven is an even better place with you in it

🎭 𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐄 𝐀 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐄𝐑 𝐒𝐓𝐀𝐍𝐃𝐀𝐑𝐃 𝐎𝐅 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐈𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 🎭
𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲 | Auditions Now Open in Swinton, Manchester

If you have a deep passion for acting and are committed to building a sustainable career in the performing arts, you have found your training ground. Welcome to Marble Academy, where you turn “𝑰’𝒅 𝒍𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒂𝒄𝒕” 𝒊𝒏𝒕𝒐 “𝑰’𝒎 𝒃𝒖𝒊𝒍𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒂 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒆𝒓.”🏆

𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐌𝐀𝐑𝐁𝐋𝐄 𝐀𝐂𝐀𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐘? 

• Spotlight-accredited & multi-award-winning (including consecutive ‘𝐁𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐃𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐚 𝐒𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫’ wins) 

• Our actors land roles in award-winning films & professional productions 

• Direct, honest feedback—no empty praise, just real industry results 

• Led directly by Christian Le Feuvre (LAMDA-qualified actor & award-winning filmmaker)

🎬 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐏𝐑𝐄𝐇𝐄𝐍𝐒𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐈𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐈𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐃𝐄𝐒: 

✨ Script Analysis & Characterisation 

🎥 Acting for Camera & Screen Technique 

🎭 Audition Preparation & Room Confidence 

...plus an extensive suite of additional modules covering the complete craft.

📅 𝐂𝐋𝐀𝐒𝐒 𝐃𝐄𝐓𝐀𝐈𝐋𝐒: 

⏰ 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM 

📍 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

👉 Tap the link in our bio to read student testimonials & book your audition slot today! 🔗 www.marbleacademy.co.uk

“𝐃𝐨𝐧’𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐭𝐨; 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐇𝐀𝐕𝐄 𝐭𝐨!”

#ManchesterActors #ActingClassesManchester #ActingSchool #UKActors

sharedPost.text:
We are now in Preliminary Casting for The Prodigal Daughter. 

Set to the Biblical parable of the Prodigal Son. Is a famous story about a father who welcomes back his rebellious younger son with joy, despite the son wasting his inheritance, while the faithful older brother remains resentful. 

This story sets the stage for a daughter (early 20's) who gets her inheritance share from her late grandmother, and she thinks she can make it on her own. 

Rather than listen to the wisdom of her parents, she is rebellious and moves into a small studio apartment and takes the false advice of those who she thinks are her friends. With the influence of her "friends" she soon squanders her inheritance, and ends up loosing her studio apartment, turns to a life of drugs and prostitution..
In a state of despair, she take a blade to slit her wrists and end her life. It is true a sheer act of redemption that she decides to return back to the family home to seek forgiveness from her parents.

A story that is gripping and shows the real struggles of many that are homeless and wanting a way home, through hope.

NOTE: ALL LEAD ROLES ARE NOW GONE. ONLY LOOKING FOR SUPPORT ACTORS. 

FILMING: BLACKPOOL AREA. APRIL 2027

items.text:
Movie idea:

Title: Myrmarachne

Main areas/ Movie shoot locations: Leamington, Warwick and Willenhall Coventry. 

Main genres: Psychological horror, fantasy

Age range: 18-21

Key points: Unpaid job or travel. This is a project designed simply for fun with people to make friends with who share the same interests with film acting. 

I'm looking for people who are talented enough 😉 to take part and show a beautiful presentation of the mixture of different emotions portrayed by the characters in order to create a life-like, real story and adventure through this surreal psychological thriller with connections to supernatural, spiritual and metaphysical concepts.

Important note: The earliest the movie will most likely start being filmed is late 2027/ early 2028. This is because even though I have the plot written, i still have to finish writing other pages including multiple scripts. I think that is plenty of time for us to use and spend by getting to know each other, diving and learning about your own individual characters, learning scripts, rehearsing scenes, going over the plot and making a new friend group.

Movie description: A group of teenagers and friends begin to experience bizarre occurences within their neighborhood. During a trip in the local woods, after getting lost within a muddle of different dimensions, and after making contact with several other-worldly creatures, out of fear and panic, they get split apart. At some point, after learning that part of the supernatural is connected to heavenly love, they eventually try and get together and escape the dangers within their world and enter the "higher realms."

To apply for a role, send me: Acting CV and personal showreel (if you have these).

Please send over a 1-3 minute long self-tape of your own choice. 

Personal details: Name, height, age, city/ town, headshot.

Any questions, you can message me personally.

Further details about the plot and overall project will be released in personal groupchats and messages for people who are interested.

**STAND-IN / EXTRAS / WARSAW / CHILDREN & TEENAGERS**

We're looking for stand-ins / extras aged **1 to 17** for a movie project - no experience required, you will be asked to do very simple tasks like "opening fridge", "sitting on couch" or "turning on TV".

We are looking for kids and teenagers of the following ethnic backgrounds / appearances:
* African
* Hispanic
* Asian
* Indian

**Where:** Warsaw, Ciechanowska street.
**When:** One day between October 29th and November 6th. The shoot will take approximately 1.5 hours.
**Rate:** PLN 500, paid via BLIK. **If you come from another city, we can cover some travel expanses.**

If you are interested, please email **atlanta.int.casting@gmail.com** with the following information:
* full name
* age
* contact phone number
* current photos

You can check our agency here: www.atlantafilms.pl

Hello everyone! 🎬
My name is Alex, I’m 26 years old and based in Austria.

Acting has always been a dream of mine, and I’m now ready to finally pursue it seriously. 
I’m looking to connect with actors, filmmakers, casting professionals and anyone working on interesting projects.

I currently work at a five ⭐️ hotel in Salzburg and previously worked in the automotive industry.

I speak Romanian, German and English, and I’m open to film, TV, commercials, short films or other acting opportunities.

My long-term dream is to work internationally, especially one day in California🇺🇸

If you’re working on a project and think I could be a fit, feel free to reach out.🎥

🎤 **Street Interviewer Wanted – Germany**

We’re looking for someone based in a **major German city** to conduct street interviews for Lio.

You’ll approach people, ask about their **smoking/vaping habits**, let them try Lio, and capture their reactions. Lio mimics the familiar sensation and ritual of smoking/vaping without nicotine, smoke, or vapor, helping people quit while keeping the habit.

**€50/hour — approx. 3 hours per session.**

We’ll send you the product beforehand.

If the content performs well, we’d love to make this a **long-term collaboration**.

Interested? Please send me a PM

**Kleinwüchsige Darstellerin gesucht für „Getting In", Kunsthalle Wien**

 

Honorar: EUR 700,- (Werkvertrag, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung)

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

 

„Getting In" ist ein neues Lustspiel des kanadischen Regisseurs Harkeerat Mangat für eine Darstellerin. Es erzählt die Geschichte von Maria, die von der Pflege ihrer Mutter nach Hause zurückkehrt und feststellt, dass der Zugangscode zu ihrem Wohnhaus geändert wurde. Ausgesperrt muss sie ihre exzentrischen Nachbar*innen davon überzeugen, sie hereinzulassen. Premiere am 17. November 2026 um 19:00 Uhr in der Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz.

 

Alle Details: https://kunsthallewien.at/veranstaltung/performance-harkeerat-mangat-getting-in

**Die Rolle: Maria**

 

Wir suchen eine kleinwüchsige Frau, ca. 100 bis 150 cm, ca. 35 bis 65 Jahre, für die Rolle der Maria, die einzige Live-Rolle des Stücks.

 

Das Bühnenbild ist ein Modell-Wohnhaus von drei Metern Höhe, und die Bewohner*innen, die Maria zu überzeugen versucht, sind sehr klein. Die Dimensionen des Stücks funktionieren nur mit einer kleinwüchsigen Darstellerin.

 

Marias Sprache ist für das Publikum nicht verständlich. Der Text muss daher nicht auswendig gelernt werden. Die Bewegungsabläufe müssen einstudiert werden, es gibt darin aber Raum für Improvisation.

 

Da eine erfundene Sprache immer nach jener Sprache klingt, aus der sie kommt, suchen wir jemanden, der österreichisches Deutsch als Muttersprache oder auf muttersprachlichem Niveau spricht. Das Kauderwelsch soll österreichisch klingen.

 

Schauspielerfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen auf jedem Erfahrungsstand, auch von Personen, die noch nie auf einer Bühne gestanden sind.

 

**Zeitplan**

 

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Vorsprechen: Woche ab 26. Oktober 2026, via Zoom

Erste Probe: Wochenende 30. Oktober bis 1. November 2026, vor Ort

Zweite Probe: Woche ab 9. November 2026

Endprobe auf der Bühne: 17. November 2026, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr

 

Stundenausmaß: drei Proben à maximal vier Stunden sowie die Aufführung, gesamt ca. 14 Stunden.

** **

**Engagement und Honorar**

 

EUR 700,- gesamt auf Werkvertragsbasis, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung. Das Honorar orientiert sich an der Honoraruntergrenze der IG Freie Theaterarbeit. Auftraggeber: Harkeerat Mangat.

 

**Bewerbung**

 

Bitte schick bis 23. Oktober 2026 eine E-Mail an casting@harkeeratmangat.com mit:

 

1. Einem Foto von dir. Ein Handyfoto genügt völlig, es muss kein professionelles Foto sein.

2. Deinem Namen, Alter und deiner Körpergröße.

3. Ob du schon einmal gespielt hast, und wenn ja, kurz was. „Keine Erfahrung" ist eine völlig gute Antwort.

4. Ob du österreichisches Deutsch sprichst und ob es deine Alltagssprache ist.

 

Mehr braucht es nicht. Kein Lebenslauf, kein Showreel und kein Motivationsschreiben.

 

**Über den Künstler **

 

Harkeerat Mangat (geb. 1990 in Vancouver) ist kanadischer Filmemacher und Theaterregisseur und lebt in Wien. Sein Film „Fürstenplatz" und sein großangelegtes Theaterprojekt „Sommer-Kultur-Fest" wurden mit dem Vordemberge-Gildewart-Preis ausgezeichnet. Einzelausstellungen hatte er im Bonner Kunstverein, in der Stiftung Museum Insel Hombroich und im kjubh Kunstverein; Performances zeigte er im Kunstverein Gartenhaus, Wien, und in der Zweigstelle Capitain, Neapel.

 

Er entwirft Szenarien, innerhalb derer die Darsteller*innen frei improvisieren, und arbeitet sowohl mit professionellen als auch mit nicht-professionellen Schauspieler*innen.

 

KONTAKT

 

Harkeerat Mangat

casting@harkeeratmangat.com

🎬 CASTING CALL — ACTOR NEEDED FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM (£50)
Hi everyone! We are looking for an actor to play George in a university short film project for London Metropolitan University.

About the project:

Cause and Effect is a short film created as part of our university course. The script is very simple and easy to follow.

ROLE: GEORGE (18/19 years old)

• Male actor

• George is Deaf and communicates with his mother through British Sign Language (BSL)

• The role is very simple — George only has one sentence in the entire film

• BSL guidance will be provided

📅 Filming: This Saturday only

⏰ 10:00am – 1:00pm

📍 London

💷 £50 expenses/compensation

This is a student production for London Metropolitan University, and it is a great opportunity to gain experience working on a short film and add the project to your portfolio/showreel.

If you are interested, please DM me with a recent photo and a little information about yourself/your acting experience.

Feel free to tag or share with anyone who might be interested! 🎥

Hello everyone! We’re casting David and Bridget for our upcoming short film ***Boarding Home***.

**Logline:** When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she’s really there.

We’re looking for actors who connect with the characters and are looking for something interesting to play. If David or Bridget catches your attention, we’d love to see your audition.

**Casting Details:**
**Non-Union | Unpaid | Meals Provided on Set | IMDb Credit | Professional Reel Footage**
**Shooting Date:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Audition Dates:** October 25 – November 1 

**Shooting Location:** Toronto, Ontario

**Interested?** Please send your headshot, resume, and demo reel to jonosei@horizondreamproductions.ca.

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

TITLE & TYPE: War Within – Short Film (60–90 sec), paid

CREW CALL: Cinematographer / Director

LOCATION: Orange County, CA

TIME(S): Half-day shoot, mid-to-late November

CONTACT: DM me or text 949-687-7389 with your reel

War Within is a small Christian hat brand in OC. This isn't a commercial. I want an intimate, moody, cinematic short that feels like a story about the battle we each fight inside. Paid, with full creative credit and reel rights. Students and emerging filmmakers welcome. If the first film is a fit, I want to make it an ongoing series, so more paid work is likely.
